name: game_tick
note: input_poll -> DAT_7af4; applies mouse deltas (DS:7a28/7a2a) to cursor DAT_7bd6/7bd8 clamped to bounds 79cc..79d2; software cursor save/restore; every 50/speed ticks: random_events (if DAT_7a3c), building_animate, room_animate(1), office Tetris step (room 1 substate 2 -> tetris_tick); room_hover; clock_update(0). Returns door/room id (byte from door table DS:7c80+floor*0x7a+door) when the human figure arrives at a door, else 0

name: screen_update
note: vga_wait_vsync; composites software cursor into DAT_8e62 (320x120 offscreen) when in building view or office Tetris, blits 8e62 to screen (scr_blit_rect with elevator-dependent window if DAT_7a24==1, else scr_blit at 0,0); 125 call sites

name: lower_screen_present
note: presents lower panel bitmap DAT_8eb2 (320x80) at y=0x78 via screen_wipe_in(...,dir 0,delay 1) + scr_blit, keeping cursor sprite consistent; called once from game_main

name: text_input
c_signature: int16_t text_input(int16_t x, int16_t y, int16_t max_cols, char *buf)
note: modal line editor using kbd_getkey game key codes (A-Z/a-z 0x26..0x3f, digits 0x0a..0x13, space 0x20, backspace 0x21), draws into DAT_8e62 with draw_string + cursor glyph DS:0d33; returns 0 on Enter (0x1f), -1 on ESC (0x14). ADD SP,0xa

name: set_cursor_shape
note: shape!=0: push current cursor DAT_79b2 on stack DS:8f02[0d28++] and set shape (3 = busy); shape==0: pop. no-op if DAT_0390:0392 (alt input mode) set

name: tetris_tick
note: hidden Tetris mini-game on the office computer (room 1, substate 2): 7 pieces x 4 rotations (DS:039c, 16 bytes each), board 10x20 at DS:8ab4, input DAT_7a62 (1..5 set by hotkey_handle), next piece via rand_range(7,1); drop=1 moves piece down

name: draw_tile_box
c_signature: void draw_tile_box(int16_t xcol, int16_t y, int16_t wcols, int16_t h, int16_t style)

name: draw_tile_box_to
c_signature: void draw_tile_box_to(int16_t xcol, int16_t y, int16_t wcols, int16_t h, int16_t style, Bitmap *dst)
note: draws a box from 8x8 tiles of UI bank DAT_8c3c (corners style*3+0x13/0x15) and DAT_8b80 (edges style+0xe), rows of 8 px until h exhausted
